The '''Zelaba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Outer Jalor sector/Legends|Outer Jalor sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelaba]].
